title: Catch lete waqt haath PEECHE kyun kheenchte hain?
description: Season 2 Episode 11: The change in momentum is fixed; spreading it over more time means less force — impulse.
ncert_chapter: NCERT XI Ch 4 (impulse, F·Δt = Δp — the cricket example is literally in the NCERT text)
hook_text: Fielder haath peeche kyun kheenchta hai? 🏏 Style nahi, physics
concept: The change in momentum is fixed; spreading it over more time means less force — impulse.
on_screen_cues: "Δp = fixed" → "F × Δt = Δp" → "Δt ↑ ⇒ F ↓" → airbag / helmet / bent knees icons → "IMPULSE · NCERT XI Ch 4"
pinned_comment: Glass ke floor pe girna zyada dard karta hai ya gadde pe — aur physics mein iska EK word kya hai? 👇
suggested_titles: "Catch lete waqt haath peeche kyun kheenchte hain? 🏏" / "Airbag kaise bachata hai — Impulse 60 sec mein"
elevenlabs_script:
Gudiya: [curious] Chintu, fielder catch lete hue haath peeche kyun kheenchta hai? Style ke liye?
Chintu: [laughs] Nahi! Haath bachaane ke liye!
Gudiya: [confused] Kaise?
Chintu: [excited] Ball ko rokna hai. Uska momentum zero karna hai. Yeh fix hai. Par kitna TIME loge, yeh tumhare haath mein hai!
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Toh?
Chintu: [cheerfully] Force into time equals momentum ka change. Time badhao... force kam!
Gudiya: [surprised] Matlab haath peeche kheench ke fielder time badha raha hai?
Chintu: [elated] Exactly! Same ball, same speed... par force aadha, chauthai!
Gudiya: [curious] Aur agar haath ekdum sakht rakha?
Chintu: [deadpan] Same momentum, chhota time, BADA force. Ungli tooti.
Gudiya: [gasps] Toh airbag bhi?
Chintu: [excited] Airbag! Helmet! Gadda! Sab time badhaate hain. Physics ek hai, product alag alag!
Gudiya: [curious] Aur jump karke land karte waqt ghutne kyun modte hain?
Chintu: [cheerfully] Wahi! Time badhaya, force ghataya. Seedhe pair se kudo... ghutna gaya.
Gudiya: [elated] Matlab jahan bhi takkar hai, time badhao aur bach jao!
Chintu: [proudly] Isko IMPULSE bolte hain. NCERT mein yahi cricket ka example hai!
Gudiya: [curious] Chintu, friction toh dushman hai na? Sab kuch slow kar deti hai.
Chintu: [deadpan] Wrong! Woh next video mein!
